hints.title: Recyclable Identifier Pool
hints.text: Keep an ordered pool of released user identifiers and an incrementing counter for fresh user identifiers.

hints.title: Bidirectional File Chunk Mapping
hints.text: Map user IDs to owned chunk sets, and chunk IDs to sets of user IDs holding that chunk.

hints.title: Dynamic Chunk Acquisition
hints.text: When a user requests chunkID, return all users owning that chunk sorted ascending, and add chunkID to the requesting user ownership.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Min-heap provides O(log U) allocation, and inverted chunk index retrieves holders in sorted order.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning every user linearly on each chunk query takes O(U) operations per request.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual user-to-chunks and chunk-to-users maps optimize request time at the cost of dual storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Min-heap for smallest reusable ID paired with inverted index for chunk peers.
